content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I appreciate the solutions shared above. I would like to know if it's possible to activate the weekly timer 5 hours earlier than the set time. I see that the block does not include an Enable pin, and it's also not possible to directly subtract from the time value.

I'm not aware of any solution to start the weekly timer 5 hours before its activation time. Instead, consider setting the switch-on (and switch-off, if needed) times for the weekly timer 5 hours earlier than planned, to allow preparatory tasks in advance. After that, implement a switch-on delay of 5 hours to start the actual process once the delay has elapsed. To assist further, more details would be helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is searching for a way to have the weekly timer function activate 5 hours prior to its scheduled time. However, the current weekly timer block lacks an enable pin and does not allow direct adjustment of the timer value, leading to some workflow restrictions. Another participant confirmed this limitation and proposed a workaround, which emphasizes the need for more adaptable timer controls and highlights a gap in available features.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the weekly timer block to support built-in flexibility, such as having an enable pin or an easy method for dynamically adjusting the activation time.
